goal: Implement the three public functions in src/importer.py as a production-style CSV import pipeline. Accept a UTF-8 BOM and any header order with all required columns id,owner,amount,date; ignore extra columns and parse RFC-style quoted CSV. Normalize IDs with Unicode NFKC, strip and casefold; normalize owner by trimming and collapsing Unicode whitespace. Amount must be a strictly positive plain decimal with one or two fractional digits and no surrounding spaces, converted exactly to cents. Date must be a real Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Collect row errors with physical line numbers and skip invalid rows while preserving valid rows. Deduplicate by normalized ID using newest date, or later row on a tie, while retaining each ID's first-seen position. import_to_file must return the parse result, create parent directories, and atomically replace a deterministic UTF-8 JSON array only when there are no errors; on errors leave any prior file untouched. load_records must recreate the immutable Record tuple and propagate missing-file errors. Keep the declared API and do not edit tests.
criteria: CSV header, quoting, Unicode normalization, exact money and date validation work
Errors are collected with line numbers and deduplication is deterministic
Snapshot writes are atomic and round-trip without replacing prior output on errors
